qc = QuantumCircuit(3)
# Toffoli(q[0], q[2], q[1]) using only H, T, Tdg, CX
qc.h(1)
qc.cx(2, 1)
qc.tdg(1)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.t(1)
qc.cx(2, 1)
qc.tdg(1)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.t(2)
qc.t(1)
qc.h(1)
qc.cx(0, 2)
qc.t(0)
qc.tdg(2)
qc.cx(0, 2)
claim: Implements Toffoli gate with controls q[0] and q[2], target q[1], using the standard KKL decomposition with H, T, Tdg, and CX gates.

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(3)
# Flip q[2] if q[0]=1 AND q[1]=0
# Equivalent: flip q[2] if q[0]=1 and NOT q[1]
qc.x(1)
qc.ccx(0, 1, 2)
qc.x(1)
claim: Flips q[1] to invert its value, applies Toffoli to q[2] controlled by q[0] and inverted q[1], then flips q[1] back, effectively applying X to q[2] when q[0]=1 and q[1]=0.

# Controlled-SWAP (Fredkin) with control q[2], swaps q[0] and q[1]
qc.cx(1, 0)
qc.ccx(2, 0, 1)
qc.cx(1, 0)
claim: Implements Fredkin gate by using CX and Toffoli gates to swap q[0] and q[1] when q[2]=1, leaving them unchanged when q[2]=0.

# CCZ on q[0..2] using only H and CCX (at most 3 gates)
qc.h(2)
qc.ccx(0, 1, 2)
qc.h(2)
claim: Implements CCZ gate by sandwiching a Toffoli gate between H gates on the target (q[2]), which conjugates CCX to CCZ, using exactly 3 gates.

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(3)
# Phase oracle: multiply |100> and |110> by -1
# Pattern: q[2]=1 and q[0]=0
qc.x(0)
qc.cz(2, 0)
qc.x(0)
claim: Marks states where q[2]=1 and q[0]=0 by flipping q[0], applying CZ to phase-flip when both q[2] and q[0] are 1, then flipping q[0] back, thereby multiplying |100> and |110> by -1.

qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
# Grover diffusion operator 2|s><s| - I where |s> = |++>
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.z(0)
qc.z(1)
qc.cz(0, 1)
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
claim: Implements 2|s><s| - I by applying H gates, then Z gates on each qubit and a CZ between them (phase flip to |00> state), then H gates, mapping |s> to |00> and back.

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
# One Grover iteration searching for |10>, starting from |++>
# Initialize |++>
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
# Oracle: mark |10> (q[1]=1, q[0]=0)
qc.x(0)
qc.cz(0, 1)
qc.x(0)
# Diffusion operator
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
qc.z(0)
qc.z(1)
qc.cz(0, 1)
qc.h(0)
qc.h(1)
claim: Executes one complete Grover iteration: prepares |++> superposition, applies oracle to mark |10> with -1 phase, then applies Grover diffusion operator.
